target_customer: Lenders, fintechs and companies that extend credit to their own customers
problem: Building credit underwriting and monitoring infrastructure in house is slow and expensive.
business_model: B2B infrastructure SaaS for credit decisioning and monitoring

founders.name: Tomer Biger
founders.background_notes: Worked with Moran Mishan at WeWork on underwriting infrastructure per a Calcalist and search coverage; the press release says he wanted the infrastructure he wished he had while building lending products.

exit.reason: Not stated; StartupNationCentral lists it as non active, ceased operating Nov 2024.

competitors.name: Bloom Credit
competitors.what: API platform for credit bureau data

competitors.name: Zest AI
competitors.what: AI credit underwriting software for lenders
competitors.traction_then: Credit union and bank customers named

technical_complexity.rationale: Modular underwriting components, data integrations and monitoring; mostly standard engineering with data partner work.

defensibility.rationale: Embedded decisioning could lock in customers, but several funded rivals sold similar credit infrastructure.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows incumbents copying or buying Noble.

market_need_then: Embedded finance and buy now pay later were growing in 2021 and many companies wanted credit products; the founders cite their own pain building lending products.

branding.domain_note: Uses benoble.io (prefix coinage) because noble.com style domains were taken.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic word shared by an agency, a blockchain and others; searches for the brand returned unrelated firms.

outcome_analysis: Noble was founded by two ex WeWork colleagues who built underwriting infrastructure, raised a seed in 2021 and an 18 million dollar Series A led by Insight Partners in September 2022, a strong outcome for a YC company. It is listed as ceasing operations in November 2024 and no public cause was found; the funding downturn for fintech and a crowded credit infrastructure field are plausible but unsourced, so the failure factor is recorded as other.
notes: Seed 3M dated 2021-03 rests on a single database (Startupim); TLV Partners says it led the 2021 seed. Press differs: some outlets say Series A was 15M bringing total to 18M, the press release says 18M Series A; StartupNationCentral total raised 21.0M matches 3M seed plus 18M. Shutdown date rests on one directory. Competitor entries are founding era examples from search results, with amounts as reported then. Confidence high reflects sourced founders, competition and funding; the shutdown cause is not public.
